SELECT LEVEL, C.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT COMMENT_NO_BOARD, COMMENT_CONTENT_BOARD,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD < 1 / 24 / 60 --초단위 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD < 1 / 24 -- 분단위 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD < 1 -- 시간단위 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD,
BOARD_NO, MEMBER_NO, WORKER_NICKNAME, BUSINESS_NAME , PARENT_COMMENT_NO, COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" USING(MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}) C WHERE ( COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N' OR 0 != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" SUB WHERE SUB.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = C.COMMENT_NO_BOARD AND COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N') ) START WITH PARENT_COMMENT_NO IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR COMMENT_NO_BOARD = PARENT_COMMENT_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY COMMENT_NO_BOARD
